input.operation: an import call that happens to target an already-pack-managed server, WITHOUT an explicit replace flag/intent

expected.reason: Because MSC 1's importer has zero re-import guard of any kind (phase8-scope.md's own words: "no such guard exists to port"), Phase 8 cannot simply reuse 'this is a pack-import call' as the signal that whole-pack replacement was intended -- an accidental or ambiguous re-import against a pack-managed server without an explicit replace intent should be refused the same as any other individual-looking mutation, not silently treated as an authorized replace.

notes: This is a design requirement, not an MSC 1 behavior -- recorded so P8.9's contract and P8.21's implementation don't treat 'targets a pack-managed server' and 'explicit replace' as the same signal.
